# Perform a t-test to compare the mean degree completion rates between males and females
import scipy.stats as stats

male_degrees = df_filtered[df_filtered["Sex of respondent, 1979"] == 1]["Highest grade completed, 1979"]
female_degrees = df_filtered[df_filtered["Sex of respondent, 1979"] == 2]["Highest grade completed, 1979"]

t_statistic, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(male_degrees, female_degrees)
